base_model: ResembleAI/chatterbox (multilingual, MIT, ~0.5B, 23 languages incl. Hindi so Devanagari is in the tokenizer)

method.lora: rank 32 on the T3 module, from the Hindi language id
method.tokenizer: extend for Nepali-specific characters, init new rows from Devanagari equivalents (as in reenigne314/chatterbox-indic-lora: 2,454 -> 2,871 tokens)

data: same as configs/openf5_nepali.json (IndicVoices-R + Rasa Nepali, held-out speakers excluded)
eval: pipeline/evaluate.py on the same held-out speakers + NepTTS-Bench sentences; ship whichever of F5 / Chatterbox wins
rejected_alternative: FunAudioLLM/CosyVoice2-0.5B: speech tokenizer trained only on zh/en/ja/ko; maintainer recommends >=5,000h for a new language (Turkish came out unintelligible), FunAudioLLM/CosyVoice issues #466, #830
